 │ KEYS                                        │ │ LEGEND                                      │
 │                                             │ │                                             │
 │ NORMAL — the cursor on a column             │ │ PRIORITY — the left edge of a card          │
 │   hjkl ←↓↑→   columns, and the band         │ │   ▌ low                                     │
 │   i           insert mode                   │ │   ▌ normal                                  │
 │   a           a new task                    │ │   ▌ high                                    │
 │   ⇧A          show what was archived        │ │   ▌ critical                                │
 │   ⇧X          archive every task in this    │ │                                             │
 │ column — it asks first                      │ │ STALLED — the top right of a card           │
 │   /           search                        │ │   ⊘  blocked   waiting on somebody else     │
 │   ⇥           next tab — tasks, objectives, │ │   ◉  watching  handed over, needs a look    │
 │ the time spent                              │ │   ‖  paused    waiting on your decision     │
 │   :           command — what it answers is  │ │                                             │
 │ said until esc                              │ │ OBJECTIVES                                  │
 │   b           a new backup of the store     │ │   ▶  active    being worked towards         │
 │   ⇧B          the backups                   │ │   ‖  on-hold   not for now                  │
 │   ←→ t on timewalk the weeks, back to       │ │   ✓  reached   done with                    │
 │ today's                                     │ │   ✕  dropped   given up                     │
 │                                             │ │                                             │
 │ INSERT — the cursor on a task               │ │ ON A CARD                                   │
 │   hjkl ←↓↑→   tasks, and the band           │ │   ≡            a description exists         │
 │   gg / G      first / last in the column    │ │   ▪            steps done / total           │
 │   ⇧hjkl       move it: sideways changes     │ │   ⚑            a label                      │
 │ column, up and down change place            │ │   ↳            what is in the way           │
 │   ⏎           the detail                    │ │   2d          a deadline close by           │
 │   e           the form                      │ │   −3d         one that has passed           │
 │   f           focus or unfocus              │ │   ╔═╗         the task in focus             │
 │   d           delete                        │ ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 │   x           archive or unarchive          │
 │   esc         back to normal                │
 │                                             │
 │ DETAIL — one task, open                     │
 │   ^D ^U       walk its description, half a  │
